about: The preacher explains David's words 'With you is the First, in the day of power' (Psalm 110:3) as meaning Christ the Word, through whom God made heaven and earth, and lines up Moses, John, Luke and Mark on the word 'beginning'. He turns to the Passion and the Jews' rejection of Christ, with a chain of quotations from Isaiah, David and Moses, and then to Stephen's speech in Acts 7, which leads him to the heavenly Jerusalem, God's throne, and the Ark of the church as its likeness.

sentences.i: As David prophesied by the mouth of the Holy Spirit, saying: With you is the First, in the day of power.
sentences.n: Start here: በከመ is በ- 'in' + ከመ 'as', so 'just as, according as'. ተነበየ is the perfect, 3rd masculine singular, of the tä-stem of ነበየ 'prophesy' (the tä-stem has an active sense here). በአፈ is በ- + the construct state አፈ of አፍ 'mouth', 'by the mouth of'; in a chain, the construct is followed directly by the owner (አፈ መንፈስ ቅዱስ 'mouth-of Spirit Holy'). እንዘ ይብል is 'while he says' (እንዘ + the imperfect of ብህለ, a defective verb whose perfect is ይቤ); it opens a quotation. The quotation is Psalm 110:3 (Greek/Geʿez numbering 109:3): ምስሌከ ቀዳማዊ በዕለተ ኀይል 'with you [is] the first/the primal one, on the day of power'. ምስሌከ is ምስለ 'with' + -ከ 'you'; ቀዳማዊ is 'first, primordial'; በዕለተ is በ- + construct ዕለተ 'day-of'. The writer reads this as the Son being 'with' the Father at creation, which the next units develop. (The sense of the verse as it stands in the Geʿez is a short nominal sentence with no verb; 'is' is added in English.)

sentences.i: For Moses said at the head of his book: In the beginning God made heaven and earth.
sentences.n: Start here: the quotation is Genesis 1:1, rendered here from the Geʿez: በቀዳሚ ገብረ እግዚኣብሔር ሰማየ ወምድረ. እስመ is 'for, because'. ይቤ is the perfect of ብህለ, 'he said'. ውስተ ርእሰ መጽሐፉ is ውስተ 'in, at' + the construct ርእሰ 'head-of' + መጽሐፉ 'his book' (መጽሐፍ + -ሁ), i.e. 'at the head of his book', the first words of Genesis. In the quotation ገብረ is the perfect, 3rd masculine singular, 'he made' (this word can also be a noun, 'servant'; the objects ሰማየ ወምድረ make plain that it is the verb), and በቀዳሚ is በ- 'in' + ቀዳሚ used as a noun, 'in the beginning'. The preacher now takes the word 'beginning' as a title of Christ.

He-said John son-of Zebedee apostle concerning Christ: This-is first that-we-heard and-that-we-saw and-that-we-examined and-that-they-touched our-hands, and-we-declare-to-you that was our-share with-him, and-you-also who you-believed by-our-word you-will-be share with-us.
sentences.i: Understand, then: 'in the beginning' means 'in Christ'; the word 'beginning' is interpreted as Christ. John the apostle, the son of Zebedee, said concerning Christ: This is the Beginning, which we heard, and saw, and looked at closely, and our hands touched; and we declare to you that our share is with him; and you also, who believed through our word, will be sharers with us.
sentences.n: Start here: ለብዉኬ is read as ለብዉ + the particle -ኬ 'then'; ለብዉ looks like a form of ለበወ 'understand' (an imperative 'understand!'), but the vowels as printed (lä-bə-wu) fit neither the plural imperative nor the perfect, so the parse is a guess (?). The preacher explains: በቀዳሚ ብሂል በክርስቶስ ብሂል 'in-the-beginning means in-Christ'; ቀዳሚ ትርጓሜሁ ክርስቶስ 'beginning, its interpretation, [is] Christ' (ትርጓሜ 'interpretation, translation' + -ሁ 'its'). Then comes 1 John 1:1-3, quoted loosely: ዝውእቱ is ዝ 'this' + ውእቱ 'is/he', 'this is'; the relative clauses ዘሰማዕነ ወዘርኢነ ወዘጠየቅነ ወዘገሰሳ እደዊነ are ዘ- 'that which' + perfects, first person plural: ሰማዕነ 'we heard', ርኢነ 'we saw', ጠየቅነ 'we examined closely'; the fourth verb ገሰሳ 'they touched' is the 3rd feminine plural perfect of ገሰሰ, agreeing with እደዊነ 'our hands' (እድ is a feminine noun). ወንዜንወክሙ is ወ- + the 1st plural imperfect of ዜነወ 'tell, declare' + -ክሙ 'to you'. ኮነ ክፍልነ is 'our share was/is' (ኮነ, 3rd masculine perfect, agreeing with ክፍል). ወአንትሙኒ is ወ- + አንትሙ 'you (mp)' + -ኒ 'also'. ትከውኑ is the 2nd plural imperfect of ኮነ, 'you will be', and ክፍለ is in the accusative as predicate. This is not word-for-word 1 John 1:1-3; the chapter gives its own wording.

sentences.i: And as Luke the disciple said in the Acts of the Apostles: The first account we made concerning all things. And this that he said: Christ became the ransom of all; and we too believe in him. And Mark the evangelist wrote at the head of his book, and said: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
sentences.n: Start here: three beginnings are quoted. (1) Acts 1:1 (Luke's 'first account'): ቀዳሚሁ ለነገር ገበርነ በእንተ ኵሉ, literally 'the first of the account we made concerning all'. ቀዳሚሁ is ቀዳሚ + -ሁ 'its', anticipating the ለ- phrase 'of the account' (a common Geʿez way of showing 'of'); ነገር is 'word, account, matter'; ገበርነ is the 1st plural perfect of ገብረ 'make, do' (Acts has 'I'; the Geʿez text has 'we'). ረድእ is 'disciple', ግብረ ሐዋርያት 'acts-of apostles'. (2) The writer adds his own comment: ዘንተ ዘይቤ is 'this [that] he said'; ኮነ ቤዛ ኵሉ is 'became the ransom of all' (ቤዛ 'ransom, redemption'). ወንሕነኒ is ወ- + ንሕነ 'we' + -ኒ 'also, too'. አመነ ቦቱ is 'believed in him', but አመነ is the 3rd masculine singular perfect (not 'we believed', which would be አመንነ); the form as printed does not agree with 'we' (?), and I render it as a present, 'we believe'. (3) Mark 1:1: ወንጌላዊ 'evangelist'; ጸሐፈ 'he wrote'; ወይቤ 'and he said'; ቀዳሚሁ ለወንጌል 'beginning-of the-gospel'; ወልደ እግዚኣብሔር 'Son-of God' (construct state ወልደ). The three authors are lined up on one word: 'beginning'.

sentences.i: This, too, means Christ, the preaching also of the prophets and apostles; and we have been united by his grace. And again John the evangelist wrote, saying: In the beginning he was the Word, and that Word was with God.
sentences.n: Start here: ወዝንቱኒ is ወ- 'and' + ዝንቱ 'this' + -ኒ 'also, too'. ብሂል ክርስቶስ is 'means Christ' (see ብሂል, unit 2). ስብከትኒ is ስብከት 'preaching' + -ኒ 'also'; the whole is a loose chain: 'this too means Christ — the preaching too of the prophets and apostles — and we were united by his grace'. ኀበርነ is the 1st plural perfect of ኀበረ 'be joined, be united' ('we were united'; a 3rd masculine verb with 'us' would be ኀበረነ, with the first order ረ); በጸጋሁ 'by his grace' (በ- + ጸጋ + -ሁ). Then John 1:1 (ቀዳሚሁ is again ቀዳሚ + -ሁ; as an opening adverb 'in the beginning' I take it as a set phrase (?)): ቀዳሚሁ ቃል ውእቱ ወውእቱ ቃል ኀበ እግዚኣብሔር ውእቱ, 'in the beginning [the] Word was; and that Word was with God'. Geʿez has no separate past 'was': the pronoun ውእቱ 'he/is' serves as the copula, and ኀበ 'at, with' is the preposition. The third clause of John 1:1 ('and God was the Word') follows in the next unit. See the note on ምስሌከ at unit 1: 'with' (ምስለ / ኀበ) is the key idea in both verses.

sentences.i: And again he made his word exact, and said (?) likewise: In the beginning God was the Word.
sentences.n: Start here: ወዳግመ is ወ- + ዳግመ 'again, a second time'. አጠየቀ is the causative (a-stem) perfect of ጠየቀ 'examine, be exact', 'he made precise'; ቃሎ is ቃል 'word' + -ሁ 'his', accusative. The next two words are printed ወይ ፡ ቤ, split by the wordspace; I read it as ወይቤ 'and he said' (ወ- + ይቤ) broken by a stray space, but it is a corrupt-looking place and I mark it (?). ወከማሁ is ወ- + ከማሁ 'likewise, like him'. The quotation is the last clause of John 1:1, but printed in an unusual order: ቀዳሚሁ እግዚኣብሔር ውእቱ ቃል, 'in the beginning God he [the] Word' — the Geʿez has God as the subject ('God is the Word'), not 'the Word is God'. The preacher reads the word order as itself significant (God = Word).

sentences.n: Start here: ይእዜኒ is ይእዜ 'now' + -ኒ 'also, indeed'; ኬ is a particle, 'then, so' (?). ጠይቅ is the 2nd masculine singular imperative of ጠየቀ 'examine' (it could instead be the adjective 'exact', 'it is exact that'; I take the imperative). ከመ ውእቱ ቃለ አብ ክርስቶስ ውእቱ is 'that the Word of the Father [ቃለ አብ, construct state] is Christ'. በዘ ቦቱ ገብረ is በዘ 'in that, because' + ቦቱ 'in/by him' (በ + -ቱ) + ገብረ 'he made' (3rd masculine singular perfect); ፍጥረተ is the accusative of ፍጥረት 'creation', with ኵሎ 'all'. The sense follows John 1:3 and Colossians 1:16.

sentences.i: He created, and without him nothing came to be, not anything at all.
sentences.n: Start here: John 1:3, in the Geʿez wording of this text. ውእቱ ፈጠረ is 'he created' (ፈጠረ, 3rd masculine perfect). ዘእንበሌሁሰ is ዘእንበለ 'without' + -ሁ 'him' + the contrastive particle -ሰ (the -ሰ marks the contrast, 'and as for without him'). አልቦ is 'there is not'; ዘኮነ is ዘ- 'that which' + ኮነ 'became, came to be'; ወኢምንተኒ is ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + ምንት 'what, anything' + -ኒ, 'and not anything' (the -ኒ strengthens the negative).

sentences.l: He-said and-they-became, and-he he-commanded and-they-were-created; and-third glory hear; and-by-breath-of his-mouth all their-power; this-also he-shows to-spirit holy that-was-said exactly; and-what we-say;
sentences.i: He spoke, and they came to be; he commanded, and they were created. And hear the third glory: by the breath of his mouth came all their power. This also shows the Holy Spirit, who was spoken of exactly. And what shall we say?
sentences.n: Start here: the first two clauses echo Psalm 33:9 (Greek 32:9) and Psalm 148:5: 'he said, and they came to be; he commanded, and they were created'. ወኮኑ is the 3rd plural perfect of ኮነ 'become'; ተፈጥሩ is the tä-stem (passive) 3rd plural perfect of ፈጠረ, 'they were created'; አዘዘ is 'he commanded'. ሣልስ ክብር ስማዕ is 'third glory, hear!' (ስማዕ, 2nd masculine singular imperative of ሰምዐ); I take 'third glory' to be the third person of the Trinity, the Spirit (?), because the next clause quotes Psalm 33:6: ወበእስትንፋሰ አፉሁ ኵሉ ኀይሎሙ, 'and by the breath-of his-mouth [came] all their power' (አፉሁ is አፍ + -ሁ; the verb is not stated). ዝኒ ያርኢ ለመንፈስ ቅዱስ: ዝኒ is ዝ + -ኒ 'this also'; ያርኢ is the 3rd masculine imperfect of አርአየ 'show', and the ለ- before መንፈስ marks the object. ዘተብህለ is ዘ- 'which' + the tä-stem perfect of ብህለ 'was said'; ጥዩቀ is an accusative adverb, 'exactly, plainly'. ወምንተ ንብል is 'and what do we say' (1st plural imperfect of ብህለ).

sentences.l: Let-us-weep-for-them woe-to-them for-the-Jews and-for-the-heathen who they-were-confused(?) from-righteousness and-refused bowing(?) to-love-of God which he-loved-him, the-man, in-his-goodness;
sentences.i: Let us weep for them, alas for them: the Jews and the heathen, who were thrown into confusion (?) away from righteousness, and refused to submit (?) to the love of God, the love with which he loved humankind in his goodness.
sentences.n: Start here: ንብኪዮሙ is a 1st plural jussive of ብከየ 'weep' + the object ‑ዮሙ 'for them' ('let us weep for them'); አሌሆሙ is አሌ 'woe' + -ሆሙ 'to them'. ለአይሁድ ወለአረሚ is 'for the Jews and for the heathen' (አረሚ 'pagan, non-believer'); the ለ- marks them as the objects of the lament. እለ ዐውከኩ is a corrupt-looking place: እለ is the PLURAL relative 'who', but ዐውከኩ is a FIRST-person singular perfect ('I was troubled'); I read it as a slip for a 3rd plural form of ዐውከ 'be troubled, stirred up, confused' (?) and render 'who were thrown into confusion'; the meaning 'from righteousness' (እምጽድቅ) comes with it. ወአበዩ is 'and they refused' (አበየ). ገኒየ is a form of ገነየ 'bow, serve, submit', taken as a verbal noun or gerund-like form, 'submission, bowing' (?) (the ending is not the regular gerund -ዖ); ለፍቅረ 'to the love-of' (construct ፍቅረ); the feminine relative እንተ agrees with ፍቅር 'love', but አፍቀሮ is the 3rd masculine singular + -ሁ, so God is the one who loved: 'the love ... which he loved him, the man' = 'the love with which he loved mankind' (the -ሁ and ለሰብእ are resumptive). በኂሩቱ 'in his goodness' (ኂሩት + -ሁ).

sentences.l: For after he-was-cast-out Adam by-his-disobedience he-saved-him by-greatness-of his-mercy, being-hanged upon wood-of cross and-being-nailed with-nails-of his-hands;
sentences.i: For after Adam was cast out because of his disobedience, he saved him by the greatness of his mercy, hanged upon the wood of the cross and nailed with the nails of his hands.
sentences.n: Start here: እምድኅረ is 'after'. ተገድፈ is the tä-stem (passive) perfect of ገደፈ 'throw away, cast out', 'was cast out' (Adam, from Paradise). በዕልወቱ is በ- 'by, because of' + ዕልወት 'disobedience, perversity' + -ሁ 'his'. አድኀኖ is the causative perfect of ድኀነ, 'he saved' (አድኀነ) + -ሁ 'him'. በዕበየ ምሕረቱ is a construct chain: 'by-greatness-of his-mercy' (ዕበየ is the construct of ዕበይ). The two gerunds ተሰቂሎ 'being hanged' (tä-stem of ሰቀለ 'hang, crucify') and ተቀኒዎ 'being nailed, pierced' (tä-stem of ቀነወ 'pierce, nail', the verb from which ቅንዋት 'nails' comes) both describe how he saved him. ዲበ ዕፀ መስቀል is 'upon the wood-of the cross' (ዲበ 'upon', ዕፀ construct of ዕፅ 'tree, wood'). Gerunds (the -o ending) are the usual way Geʿez links a string of actions without a finite verb.

sentences.i: Stretching out his arms (?) in humility, bowing his head for our sake, he suffered a suffering that did not befit him, in the greatness of his eternal divinity.
sentences.n: Start here: ሰፊሖ is the gerund of ሰፈሐ 'stretch out, spread'; the object እራሑ (printed so) should be 'his arms/hands' by context, but the word is not one I can confirm (?): it might be a spelling of ርእሱ 'his head' (but ርእሶ 'his head' follows in the next phrase), so I take it as 'arms'. አጽኒኖ is a gerund, 'bowing, inclining' (from አጽነነ) (?); ርእሶ is ርእስ 'head' + -ሁ, accusative. በእንቲአነ is 'for us, on our account' (በእንተ + -ነ). ሐመ is the perfect, 3rd masculine, of ሐመ 'suffer, be ill'. ዘኢይደልዎ is ዘ- + the negative of ይደሉ 'it befits' + -ሁ 'him', 'which was not fitting for him'; ሕማም is 'suffering', a cognate object (the accusative ending is not written). በዕበየ መለኮቱ ዘለዓለም is 'in the greatness of his eternal divinity' (መለኮት 'divinity'; ዘለዓለም is ዘ- + ለዓለም 'of eternity', i.e. 'eternal'); I render በ- as 'in'; it may carry the sense 'despite' (a suffering unfitting to such greatness), which the Geʿez leaves unsaid.

sentences.i: He died so that he might defeat death; he became weak so that he might strengthen the feeble earthly one.
sentences.n: Start here: two purpose clauses with ከመ + the jussive. ይስዐሮ is the jussive of ሰዐረ 'defeat, overcome' + -ሁ 'him', 'that he may overcome him' (the object ለሞት 'death' repeats it: this is the ለ- that marks a definite object after a pronoun suffix, a regular pattern); ያጽንዖ is the causative jussive of ጸንዐ 'be strong' ('make strong') + -ሁ; ደክመ is 'he became weak, tired'. ድኩም is 'weak, feeble'; መሬታዊ is 'earthly, of the earth' (a noun/adjective from መሬት 'soil'), here meaning the earth-made human being, Adam's kind.

sentences.l: Fasting, sipping vinegar, being-crowned crown-of thorn, he-did-not-fear and-was-not-ashamed of-insult and-scorn and-spittle-of unclean Jews;
sentences.i: Fasting, sipping vinegar, crowned with a crown of thorns, he neither feared nor was ashamed of the insults, the scorn, and the spittle of the unclean Jews.
sentences.n: Start here: a string of gerunds ending in ‑o, then two finite verbs. ጸሚኦ is the gerund of ጾመ 'fast'; ተከሊሎ is the gerund of ተከለለ 'be crowned' (tä-stem; the object is አክሊለ ሦክ 'crown-of thorn'). The two middle words are ሰሪቦ, the gerund of ሰረበ 'sip, drink', and ብሒአ, the accusative of ብሒእ 'vinegar' (glossed so in an earlier part): 'sipping vinegar'. ኢፈርሀ is 'he did not fear' (ፈርሀ) and ወኢኀፈረ is 'and he was not ashamed' (ኀፈረ); both take the accusatives ኀሳረ 'insult, loss, disgrace', ወጽዕለተ 'and scorn' (the sense of this root is not secure (?)) and ወምራቀ 'and spittle' (ምራቅ). ዘርኩሳን አይሁድ is 'of-the-unclean Jews' (ዘ- as a genitive marker + the plural adjective ርኩሳን). Isaiah 50:6 and the Passion accounts are the background (spitting, mocking). The phrase 'unclean Jews' belongs to the text's polemic; I translate it as it stands.

sentences.i: He was slapped, struck, beaten (?), nailed, reviled and scorned, though he is God, the ruler of death and the giver of glory; and so he endured every insult.
sentences.n: Start here: six verbs in a row, all in the tä-stem (passive) perfect, 3rd masculine singular: ተጸፍዐ 'was slapped' (ጸፍዐ), ተኰርዐ 'was struck' (ኰርዐ, a blow to the head or with the fist), ተረግዘ 'was beaten/struck down' (?) (ረገዘ is not secure for me), ተቀነወ 'was pierced, nailed' (tä-stem of ቀነወ, as in unit 13), ተፀርፈ 'was reviled, blasphemed' (ፀረፈ), ተጽዕለ 'was scorned' (tä-stem of ጸዐለ; the sense is not secure (?)). እንዘ አምላክ ውእቱ is 'while he is God' (እንዘ 'while, although'); መላኬ ሞት is 'ruler/master of death' (construct; መላኬ is a form of መላኪ 'ruler', and the final -ኬ is part of the word, not the particle) (?); ወሃቤ ክብር is 'giver of glory' (agent noun ወሃቢ in the construct). ወበእንተዝኬ is ወ- + በእንተ 'on account of' + ዝ 'this' + -ኬ 'then': 'and therefore'. ተዐገሰ is the tä-stem perfect of ዐገሰ 'bear, endure'; ኵሎ ኀሳረ 'every insult' (accusative).

sentences.l: The-weak-indeed and-the-lowly it-grieves-him when they-despise-him and-scorn-him, and-the-strong-indeed and-the-honored what grieves-him if they-lied against-him;
sentences.i: A weak and lowly man is grieved when they despise and scorn him; but what can grieve a strong and honored one if they lie against him?
sentences.n: Start here: ድኩምሰ is ድኩም 'weak' + the contrastive particle -ሰ ('as for the weak one'); ወኅሱር 'and lowly, diminished'. ያሐዝኖ is the causative imperfect of ሐዘነ 'be sad', 'grieves him' (አሐዘነ), with -ሁ 'him'. ሶበ is 'when' (+ perfect); መነንዎ 'they despised him' (መነነ), ወጸዐልዎ 'and they scorned him' (ጸዐለ, sense not secure (?)). The second half is a rhetorical question: ወለጽኑዕሰ ወለክቡር 'and for the strong and the honored' (ለ- 'for', -ሰ 'as for'); ምንተ is 'what?'; ለእመ is 'if'; ሐሰዉ is 'they lied' (ሐሰወ 'lie, speak falsely'); ላዕሌሁ 'against him' (ላዕለ + -ሁ). The argument: since Christ is strong and honored, the abuse could not hurt him; he bore it by choice, so that it was for us.

sentences.n: Start here: ወሎቱሰ is ወ- 'and' + ሎቱ 'to him' + -ሰ 'as for'. አልቦ ዘያአምሮ is 'there is no one who knows him' (አልቦ 'there is not', ዘ- 'who/that' + the imperfect of አእመረ + -ሁ 'him'). sentences.n: Start here: this follows 1 Corinthians 2:8 . ወሶበሰ is ወ- + ሶበ 'when, if' + -ሰ; አእመሩ is 'they knew' (3rd plural perfect of አእመረ); እመ ኢሰቀልዎ is እመ 'if' + negative ኢ- + the perfect ሰቀልዎ 'they crucified him' (ሰቀለ 'hang, crucify'), here 'they would not have crucified him'. ለእግዚአ ስብሐት: the ለ- marks the object, and እግዚአ is the construct of እግዚእ 'lord', 'the Lord of glory' (ስብሐት 'praise, glory'). The conditional uses two perfects; the force of እመ here is not clear to me (?), and I read it as introducing the result clause, not the condition.

sentences.n: Start here: Luke 23:34 (the prayer for those who crucified him). ወይቤ is 'and he said'. በምሕረቱ is 'in his mercy'. ስረይ is the 2nd masculine singular imperative of ሰረየ 'forgive'; ሎሙ is 'to them' (ለ + -ሙ); አባ is 'Father' (vocative; the title used of God, compare Mark 14:36). The Geʿez has ዘኢያአምሩ ይገብሩ, literally 'what they do not know, they do' (ዘ- + the negative imperfect ኢያአምሩ + ይገብሩ 'they do'); I keep that order.

sentences.i: They liken their Creator to a creature, and they killed the Sojourner (?), who was not of mortal making and not made by a hand. But he himself is the maker and he himself is the creator: light that is from light, God that is from God, the Son that is from the Father, Jesus Christ.
sentences.n: Start here: ያመስሉ is the 3rd plural imperfect of አምሰለ 'liken, compare' (causative of መሰለ); the object ፈጣሪሆሙ 'their creator' (ፈጣሪ + -ሆሙ) is put first for emphasis. ወቀተሉ ፈላሴ is 'and they killed ፈላሴ'; ፈላሴ is printed so, and I read it as ፈላሲ 'sojourner, stranger, one who has migrated' (?) — the word is uncertain here, but the relative clauses that follow (not of mortal creation, not made by hand) say who is meant: Christ. ዘኢኮነ is ዘ- + negated ኮነ 'who was not' and እምፍጥረተ መዋቲ is 'from the creation-of a mortal' (መዋቲ 'mortal'); በእድ is 'by a hand'. Then ወውእቱሰ ለሊሁ ገባሪ ወለሊሁ ፈጣሪ, 'and as for him, he himself is maker and he himself is creator' (ገባሪ 'maker', ፈጣሪ 'creator'). ብርሃን ዘእምብርሃን አምላክ ዘእምአምላክ ወልድ ዘእምአብ are clauses with ዘእም- (ዘ- 'who/which' + እም 'from'): this is the formula of the Nicene Creed in its Geʿez wording ('that is from'), rendered here from the Geʿez and not from the English Creed; it is the Church's own formula, not a quotation of Scripture.

sentences.i: He himself is the refuge (?), he himself is the one who feeds, he himself is the provider, he whose homeland is above the heights, above all; he humbled himself.
sentences.n: Start here: ለሊሁ is 'he himself', repeated three times. The three nouns: ምስካይ 'refuge, shelter' (?) (the meaning is not sure to me), መሴስይ 'one who feeds' (from ሴሰየ 'give to eat'), መጋቢ 'provider, one who gives' — these are agent/instrument nouns made with the prefix መ-. ውእቱ ዘህገሩ ላዕለ ዘልዑል መልዕልተ ኵሉ ተትሕተ is hard: 'he whose city (ህገር) [is] above the Most High [ዘልዑል], over all, humbled himself'. ህገር is 'city, country, homeland'; ዘልዑል is ዘ- + ልዑል 'exalted, high', here 'the height' or 'the Most High' — to say Christ's home is 'above the Most High' would be odd, so I render 'above the heights' (?). መልዕልተ is 'above, over'. ተትሕተ is the tä-stem perfect of ትሕተ 'be low', 'he humbled himself' (compare Philippians 2:8). The unit ends with ።, closing the first long run of argument.

sentences.l: As he-said Isaiah, in-chief(?)-of word among-the-prophets: Humble his-person and-his-appearance despised, like root in-earth dry; being-veiled he-came in-flesh earthly, holder-of all and-savior-of all. And-David-indeed he-adorns-him while he-says: In-your-beauty and-in-your-comeliness;
sentences.i: As Isaiah, foremost in speech (?) among the prophets, said: Humble is his person and his appearance despised, like a root in dry ground. Veiled in earthly flesh he came, the holder of all and the savior of all. David, for his part, praises his beauty, saying: In your beauty and in your comeliness.
sentences.n: Start here: በከመ ይቤ ኢሳይያስ 'as Isaiah said'; በሊኀ ቃል እምነቢያት is uncertain (?): I read በ- + ሊኀ + ቃል 'word' + እም- 'among' + ነቢያት 'prophets'; ሊኀ is not a word I can place, and may be a misprint for ሊቀ 'chief-of' (ሊቅ), giving 'chief in speech among the prophets'. The quotation is Isaiah 53:2-3 (the suffering servant): ትሑት 'humble, lowly' ብእሲሁ 'his person/man (?)' ወራእዩ 'and his appearance' ምኑን 'despised' (መነነ; compare መነንዎ in unit 18) ከመ ሥርው በምድር ጽምእት 'like a root in dry [ጽምእት, literally 'thirsty'] ground'. ተሰዊሮ is a gerund, 'being hidden/veiled' (ተሰውረ) (?), then መጽአ 'he came' (3rd masculine perfect) በሥጋ ምድራዊት 'in earthly flesh'. አኃዜ ኵሉ is the construct of አኃዚ 'holder, upholder', 'holder of all', ወመድኀኔ ኵሉ 'and savior of all'. Contrast: Isaiah sees him ugly, David sees him beautiful. ወዳዊትሰ ያስተሴንዮ: ወዳዊትሰ is 'and David, for his part' (-ሰ contrastive), and ያስተሴንዮ is the imperfect of አስተሠነየ 'adorn, praise as beautiful' + -ሁ 'him'. The next words are Psalm 45:3 (Greek numbering 44:4): በስንከ ወበላሕይከ 'in your beauty and in your comeliness' (ስንክ 'beauty', ላሕይ 'comeliness').

sentences.i: And again he said concerning the Jews, the enemies of righteousness: Your arrows are sharp, O mighty one, in the hearts of the king's enemies; in their hearts, indeed, it goes true (?); they strike them down (?). He said of those who did not wish to make me king: Let them bring them before me and strike them down (?). And again Isaiah said concerning the Jews: I sought them and did not find them; I called them and they did not answer me (?); I loved them and they hated me. And David also said: They repaid me evil in place of good, and hated me in place of those whom I loved. And again Isaiah said: With their mouths they love me, but their hearts are far from me, and in vain they worship me.
sentences.n: Start here: this is a long run of quotations, 56 words, with no ፤ at which to divide it, so I keep it whole. Each is introduced by ወካዕበ ይቤ 'and again he said'. (1) Psalm 45:5 (Greek 44:6): አሕፃከ ስሑል ኀያል ውስተ ልቦሙ ለጸላእተ ንጉሥ 'your arrows [are] sharp, O mighty one, in the heart of the king's enemies' (ስሑል 'sharp', ኀያል 'mighty', vocative; ጸላእተ is the construct of ጸላኢ 'enemies'). ፀራ ለጽድቅ 'enemies of righteousness' (ፀራ is read as 'enemies of', from ፀር 'enemy', but the form is not the ordinary plural (?); ለጽድቅ is an ለ- genitive) is the writer's own gloss on the Jews. The clause ውስተ ልቦሙሰ ይረትዕ ይርግዝዎሙ is unclear (?): ይረትዕ is 'it is straight / it goes true' and ይርግዝዎሙ 'they strike them down' (ረገዘ is not secure for me). (2) Luke 19:27, the parable of the ten minas: ለእለ ኢይፈቅዲ ያንግሡኒ ያምጽእዎሙ ቅድሜየ 'of those who did not wish [ኢይፈቅዲ, printed with an odd ending] that they make me king: let them bring them before me'; ያንግሡኒ is the causative of ነግሠ + -ኒ 'me'; the text attributes it to David or Christ as the speaker; it is not marked. (3) The words attributed to Isaiah (ኀሠሥክዎሙ ... ጸልኡኒ) resemble Isaiah 65:1-2 only in spirit; I cannot match the wording to Isaiah and give it as it stands (?). ኀሠሥክዎሙ is the 1st singular perfect of ኀሠሠ 'seek' + 'them'; ተሰጥዉኒ is 'they answered me' (?). (4) Psalm 35:12 (Greek 34:12) and Psalm 109:5 (Greek 108:5),: ፈደዩኒ 'they repaid me'; ህየንተ 'in place of'; ዘኣፍቀርክዎሙ 'whom I loved them' (the pronoun repeats the object, as in unit 12). (5) Isaiah 29:13 and Matthew 15:8-9: በአፉሆሙ ያፈቅሩኒ ወበልቦሙሰ ነዋኀ ይርሕቁ እምኔየ ወከንቶ ያመልኩኒ; ነዋኀ is 'far, long' (accusative), ከንቶ 'in vain'.

sentences.i: And as Moses said: They provoked me with their gods, and I will make them jealous with what is not a people. For they are a people lost to counsel. And as for those who say, We have no law: law was given to them, for God is the giver of law to all.
sentences.n: Start here: the quotation is Deuteronomy 32:21 (and 32:28), the passage Paul uses in Romans 10:19. አምዕዑኒ is the 3rd plural perfect of አምዐ 'provoke to anger' (the stem is uncertain (?), as in the earlier parts) + -ኒ 'me'; በአማልክቲሆሙ 'with their gods' (አማልክት, plural of አምላክ). ወአነ ኣቀንኦሙ is 'and I will make them jealous' (አቅንአ, the causative of ቀንአ 'be jealous', 1st singular + -ሙ); በዘ ኢኮነ ሕዝበ 'with what is not a people' (ሕዝበ is accusative, the predicate of ኢኮነ 'is not'). እስመ ሕዝብ ህጉላነ ምክር እሙንቱ 'for a people lost of counsel they are' (ህጉላነ is the plural of ሕጉል 'lost' (printed with ህ), followed by ምክር 'counsel'; እሙንቱ 'they are'). The preacher then turns to the Gentiles: ወእለሰ ይብሉ አልብነ ሕገ 'and as for those who say, we have no law' (እለ 'who', ‑ሰ 'as for', አልብነ 'there is not to us', ሕገ accusative); ተውህቦሙ ሕግ 'law was given to them' (tä-stem passive of ወሀበ 'give'); ወሃቤ ሕግ 'giver-of law'. The Gentiles also have a law, from God.

sentences.i: And God repaid the Jews according to their wickedness, and he dealt with the nations according to their meekness.
sentences.n: Start here: ወፈደዮሙ is ወ- + the perfect of ፈደየ 'repay' + -ሙ 'them'; ገብረ ሎሙ is 'he did to/for them'. The endings ‑ዮሙ and ‑ቶሙ are the suffix ‑ሙ 'their' after the noun's last vowel: እከዮሙ 'their wickedness' (እከይ 'evil'), የውሃቶሙ 'their meekness' (የውሃት, as in unit 28). The noun's owner is then named with ለ-: ለአይሁድ 'of the Jews', ለአሕዛብ 'of the nations' (አሕዛብ 'the nations, Gentiles'). The structure: 'according to their evil — the Jews'; 'according to their meekness — the nations'. The two halves are parallel: ወፈደዮሙ ... ወገብረ ሎሙ.

sentences.i: And again, among the seventy there were especially seven of them who were chosen for the work with the twelve apostles, for the work of the mission: with Silas and Barnabas and Mark and Luke and Paul.
sentences.n: Start here: ፸ is 70 and ፯ is 7; ፈድፋደ is 'especially, more, in addition' (accusative adverb). The numbers: ምስለ ፲ወ፪ ሐዋርያት 'with the twelve apostles' (፲ወ፪ is ፲ 10 + ወ 'and' + ፪ 2 = 12). እለ ተኀርዩ is 'who were chosen' (the tä-stem perfect of ኀረየ 'choose'; 3rd plural). ለግብር 'for the work', ለግብረ መልእክት 'for the work-of mission/message' (መልእክት 'message, mission, commission'). Silas, Barnabas, Mark, Luke and Paul are the Acts-and-epistles names; the listing as 'seven of the seventy' mixes the seven deacons of Acts 6 with Paul's companions, and I have not tried to sort it. It leads to Stephen, who was one of the seven in Acts 6:5.

sentences.i: And that Stephen said to the Jews, while he stood as a witness and they were killing him, he said to the Jews, showing them their folly in not keeping God's commandment: You received the Law by the ordinance of angels, and you did not keep it.
sentences.n: Start here: the quotation is Acts 7:53; the story is Stephen's martyrdom (Acts 7). ይቤሎሙ is 'he said to them' (ይቤ + -ሎሙ). እንዘ ይቀውም ለስምዕ is 'while he stands for witness' (ይቀውም, imperfect of ቆመ 'stand'; ስምዕ 'witness'); እንዘ ይቀትልዎ 'while they kill him' (ቀተለ). ያርእዮሙ is the causative of ርእየ 'see', 'he shows them'; እበዶሙ is እበድ 'folly, madness' + -ሙ 'their'. በእንተ ዘኢዐቀቡ is 'concerning that they did not keep' (ዐቀበ 'keep', negative perfect 3rd plural). ነሢአክሙ is the gerund of ነሥአ 'take, receive' with -ክሙ 'you' (‘you, having received’); ኦሪተ is the accusative of ኦሪት 'the Law, Torah'; በሥርዐተ መላእክት 'by ordinance-of angels' (ሥርዐተ is the construct of ሥርዐት); ኢዐቀብክሙ 'you did not keep' (2nd plural). The line repeats ይቤሎሙ ለአይሁድ twice (a doublet in the text).

sentences.i: Hearing this, they raged (?) and gnashed their teeth (?). So listen to me about what he said, 'By the ordinance of angels you did not keep the Law': the Law is the image and the shadow of that which is in heaven. And that which is in heaven is Jerusalem the free, the dwelling of the Most High, whose form (?) and making are not known by the heart of any mortal.
sentences.n: Start here: Acts 7:54 (when the crowd heard Stephen they were enraged and gnashed their teeth). ሰሚዖሙ is the gerund of ሰምዐ 'hear' + -ሙ 'they' ('having heard'). The next words are corrupt or unfamiliar: ዘንተ አብዲ ወሐቀዩ ስነኒሆሙ. ዘንተ is 'this' (accusative); አብዲ is probably አብዱ, the 3rd plural perfect of አበደ 'be mad, enraged', written with -ዲ for -ዱ as ኢይፈቅዲ in unit 29 (?); ወሐቀዩ is ወ- + a 3rd plural perfect that fits a verb ሐቀየ 'gnash' (?) — 'and they gnashed' is the sense Acts 7:54 requires; ስነኒሆሙ is 'their teeth' (ስን 'tooth', plural ስነን + -ሆሙ). Then the preacher speaks: አፅምኡኒኬ is the plural imperative of አጽምዐ 'listen' + -ኒ 'to me' + -ኬ 'then'. The Law is 'its image and its shadow' (አርአያ, ጽላሎት, with -ሃ 'her', ኦሪት being feminine) 'of that which is in heaven', as in Hebrews 8:5 and 10:1. እንተ በሰማይሰ ኢየሩሳሌም አግዓዚት: 'the [one] in heaven, as for her, [is] Jerusalem the free' — Galatians 4:26 ('the Jerusalem above is free'); አግዓዚት is the feminine of አግዓዚ 'free'. ማኅደሩ ለልዑል is 'dwelling-of the Most High'. እንተ ኢትትዐወቅ is the feminine relative + negative tä-stem imperfect of ዐወቀ 'be known', 'which is not known'; ኅብራ ወግብራ 'its (her) form (?) and its making' (ኅብር, ሕብር in the earlier parts, 'form, colour, kind'; ግብር 'work, making'), በልበ መዋቲ 'by the heart of a mortal'.

sentences.i: And in it is the throne of the Most High, ringed with fire, and four living creatures carry it (?) in their place, which is the sixth heaven; and the throne goes up to the seventh heaven, the dwelling of the Father. And there sits the one who is with his Father and his Holy Spirit, the giver of life to all.
sentences.n: Start here: ወውስቴታ is ወ- + ውስተ 'in' + -ታ 'her' (the heavenly Jerusalem). መንበሩ ለልዑል is 'the throne-of the Most High' (መንበር + -ሁ 'his' + ለ- 'of'). ክሉል is the passive participle 'encircled' (ከለለ), በእሳት 'with fire'. ወ፬ እንስሳ is 'and four living-creatures' (፬ = 4; እንስሳ 'animals, living creatures'); this is the four living creatures of Ezekiel 1 and Revelation 4:6-8, around the throne. ይጸውሩ is the 3rd plural imperfect of ጾረ 'carry'. ዘውእቱ ሳድስ ሰማይ is ዘ- + ውእቱ 'which is' + ሳድስ 'sixth' + ሰማይ 'heaven'. ወየዐርግ መንበር ለሳብዕ ሰማይ is 'and the throne goes up to the seventh heaven' (ሳብዕ 'seventh'; ለ- 'to'); another reading is 'and he goes up to the throne of the seventh heaven' (ለ- as 'of'), which the Geʿez does not exclude (?). ማኅደረ አብ 'dwelling-of Father'. ዘሀሎ ምስለ አቡሁ is 'he who is with his Father' (ሀሎ, perfect of 'be', with the sense of a state: 'is'), echoing ምስሌከ (Psalm 110:3, unit 1) and the 'with' of John 1:1 (unit 7). ወመንፈሱ ቅዱስ is 'and his Holy Spirit' (adjective after the noun); ማሕየዌ ኵሉ 'life-giver of all' (agent noun, construct): the Trinity is named.

sentences.i: And the likeness of the throne of holy Jerusalem is the Ark of the church; and the likeness of the Jerusalem that is in the heavens is the church of the nations.
sentences.n: Start here: the conclusion of the chapter. አምሳለ is the construct of አምሳል 'likeness, image', 'likeness-of'. ዘቅድስት ኢየሩሳሌም is ዘ- 'of' + ቅድስት 'holy' (feminine) + ኢየሩሳሌም. ዛቲ ይእቲ is 'this is she' (ዛቲ 'this (fem.)', ይእቲ 'she/is'), the pattern used for identification: A = B. ታቦት ዘቤተ ክርስቲያን is 'the Ark of the church'; the earthly Ark (tabot) stands for the throne of God in the heavenly Zion — the central claim of this book. ቤተ ክርስቲያን እንተ አሕዛብ is 'the church which [belongs] to the nations' (the church of the Gentiles; the feminine relative እንተ agrees with ቤተ ክርስቲያን). The final ፨ ፨ is a section mark written twice; it is kept on this unit.

glossary.መልዕልተ: መልዕልት — surface, upper part; upon (noun, construct, used as preposition) · above, on high, opposed to መትሕተ 'below' (ወትከውን መልዕልተ 'and you will be above')
glossary.መሓሪ: መሓሪ — merciful (active participle, agent noun of ምሕረ, m-ḥ-r) · 'the Merciful One', a divine title used as a noun (አውሥኦሙ መሓሪ 'the Merciful One answered them')
glossary.መሬታዊ: መሬታዊ — earthly, of the earth (adjective; formed on መሬት 'earth, soil', a word I could not check in Dillmann; here 'earthly one(s)') (?)
glossary.መሴስይ: መሴስይ — one who feeds, feeder (agent noun, from ሴሰየ 'feed') (?)
glossary.መስቀል: መስቀል — cross (noun; genitive after the construct ዕፀ)
glossary.መነንዎ: መነነ — they despised him (3mp perfect G, m-n-n, + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.መዋቲ: መዋቲ — mortal, one who dies (noun, agent form of ሞተ; genitive after the construct አዕይንተ)
glossary.መጋቢ: መጋቢ — steward, distributor (agent noun from መገበ 'feed, distribute')
glossary.መጽአ: መጽአ — he/it came (3ms perfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ማሕየዌ: ማሕየዊ — life-giver (agent noun of አሕየወ; ማሕየዌ is the construct state 'life-giver-of' before ኵሉ)
glossary.ማኅደረ: ማኅደር — dwelling-place (construct) · accusative 'a lodging' (ወወሀባ ማኅደረ 'and he gave her a lodging')
glossary.ምስካይ: ምስካይ — refuge, shelter (?) (noun; uncertain lexical call (?))
glossary.ምኑን: ምኑን — despised (passive participle of መነነ; adjective)
glossary.ምንተ: ምንት — what? (interrogative pronoun, accusative) · exclamatory 'how' (ምንተ ሠነየኒ ቃልከ 'how pleasing to me is your word')
glossary.ምድራዊት: ምድራዊ — earthly (adjective, fem. sg. ምድራዊት, qualifying ሥጋ understood)
glossary.ሞተ: ሞተ — he died (3ms perfect, G, m-w-t); ድኅረ ሞተ ሴም 'after Shem died' · noun 'death' in the figura etymologica ከመ ሞተ ኢትሙቱ 'that you not die the death' (?) · death (ሞት, noun, accusative; ነሣእነ ሞተ ወሕይወተ 'we have taken death and life')
glossary.ሠናይት: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adjective, fem. sg. ሠናይት) · used as a noun, 'good (things)' (ውስተ ሠናይት 'into good')
glossary.ሦክ: ሦክ — thorn(s) (noun, collective; dependent after the construct አክሊለ)
glossary.ርኵስ: ርኩስ — unclean (adjective, masc. sg.) · noun 'uncleanness' (እምኵሉ ርኵስ 'from all uncleanness')
glossary.ሰሪቦ: ሰረበ — sipping, drinking (gerund 3ms ሰሪቦ, s-r-b; the object is ብሒአ 'vinegar')
glossary.ስነኒሆሙ: ስን — their teeth (noun, plural ስነን 'teeth' with a suffix, + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — first (adj.) · adverbial 'first' after ኀበ (ኀበ ቀዳሚ ተወጠነ 'where it first began') · noun 'the first, the beginning' (በእንተ ቀዳሚ 'concerning the Beginning'; ቀዳሚ ትርጓሜሁ ክርስቶስ 'the beginning, its interpretation is Christ')
glossary.ቀዳሚሁ: ቀዳሚ — 'the first of / the beginning of', ቀዳሚ + -ሁ '3ms' anticipating a following ለ- genitive (ቀዳሚሁ ለነገር, ቀዳሚሁ ለወንጌል); adverbial 'in the beginning' in the quotations of John 1:1 (ቀዳሚሁ ቃል ውእቱ) (?)
glossary.ቀዳማዊ: ቀዳማዊ — first (adjective, masc. sg.; ቀዳማዊ ብእሲ 'the first man')
glossary.ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?) · accusative 'a voice' (ቃለ ሠናየ 'a good voice') · 'sound of' (construct: ቃለ ቀርን 'sound of the horn')
glossary.ቅድሜየ: ቅድመ — before me (preposition, stem ቅድሜ- + -የ '1s me')
glossary.በሊኀ: ሊኀ — unidentified (?); perhaps a misprint for ሊቀ 'chief-of' (ሊቅ), giving 'chief in speech' (በ- 'in' + ሊኀ + ቃል); possibly corrupt (?)
glossary.በልበ: ልብ — by / in the heart of (በ- 'by, in' + ልብ 'heart', construct state 'heart-of')
glossary.በምሕረቱ: ምሕረት — in his mercy (በ- 'in' + ምሕረት + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.በሥርዐተ: ሥርዐት — by the ordinance of (በ- 'by' + ሥርዐት 'ordinance, order', construct state 'ordinance-of')
glossary.በሰማያት: ሰማይ — in the heavens (በ- 'in' + plural noun)
glossary.በሰማይሰ: ሰማይ — in heaven, indeed (በ- 'in' + ሰማይ + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.በስንከ: ሥን — in your beauty (በ- 'in' + ሥን 'beauty' + -ከ '2ms your'; spelled with ስ for ሠ)
glossary.በቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — in the first (በ- + adjective used as noun 'first, former')
glossary.በቃልነ: ቃል — through our word (በ- 'by, through' + ቃል 'word' + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.በቅንዋተ: ቅንዋት — with the nails of (በ- 'with' + ቅንዋት 'nails', plural noun, construct state 'nails-of')
glossary.በኂሩቱ: ኂሩት — in his goodness (በ- 'in' + ኂሩት 'goodness, kindness', noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.በአማልክቲሆሙ: አምላክ — with their gods (በ- 'with' + አማልክት, plural of አምላክ 'god', + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.በአፈ: አፍ — by the mouth of (በ- + noun, construct አፈ)
glossary.በአፉሆሙ: አፍ — with their mouths (በ- 'with' + አፍ 'mouth' + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
glossary.በእንቲአነ: በእንተ — for our sake, on our account (preposition, stem በእንቲአ- + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.በእድ: እድ — by hand, by a hand (በ- 'by' + እድ 'hand', noun fem.)
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በክርስቶስ: ክርስቶስ — in, by Christ (በ- + proper name)
glossary.በዕለተ: ዕለት — on the day of (በ- + noun, construct 'day-of')
glossary.በዕልወቱ: ዕልወት — in his ዕልወት (በ- 'in, by' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; perhaps 'perversity'; sense unclear) (?)
glossary.በዕበየ: ዕበይ — by the greatness of (በ- 'by' + ዕበይ 'greatness', construct state 'greatness-of')
glossary.በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
glossary.በግብረ: ግብር — in the Acts / work of (በ- 'in' + ግብር 'work, deed', construct state 'work-of')
glossary.በግብር: ግብር — in work, in deed (በ- + noun)
glossary.በጸጋሁ: ጸጋ — by his grace (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.በፍጥረት: ፍጥረት — to a creature (በ- 'with, to' + ፍጥረት 'creature, creation'; ያመስሉ በ- 'liken to')
glossary.ቤ: ብህለ — and he said (second half of ወይ ፡ ቤ, read as ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of ብህለ, split by a stray wordspace) (?)
glossary.ቤተ: ቤት — house (noun, construct state 'house-of') · accusative 'the house' as object of a verb (የኀድጋ ቤተ 'they leave the house')
glossary.ቤዛ: ቤዛ — ransom, redemption (noun; ቤዛ ይስሐቅ 'ransom of Isaac', construct)
glossary.ብሂል: ብሂል — saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)
glossary.ተረግዘ: ተረግዘ — he was beaten, struck (?) (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ረገዘ; sense uncertain (?))
glossary.ተሰቂሎ: ተሰቅለ — having been hanged, hanged (converb, 3ms, passive ተ-stem of ሰቀለ)
glossary.ተሰዊሮ: ተሰወረ — having been hidden, veiled (3ms gerund, Gt, s-w-r)
glossary.ተቀነወ: ተቀነወ — he was nailed, pierced (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ቀነወ 'pierce, nail'; compare ቅንዋት 'nails')
glossary.ተትሕተ: ተትሕተ — he humbled himself (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ትሕተ 'be low')
glossary.ተኀርዩ: ተኀርየ — they were chosen (3mp perfect, tä-stem passive of ኀረየ 'choose'; subject ሕዝበ ኢትዮጵያ 'people of Ethiopia') (?)
glossary.ተነበየ: ተነበየ — he prophesied (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነበየ, n-b-y)
glossary.ተከሊሎ: ተከለለ — being crowned (gerund 3ms ተከሊሎ, tä-stem of ከለለ 'surround, crown'; ተከሊሎ አክሊለ 'crowned with a crown')
glossary.ተክዕወ: ተክዕወ — it was poured out (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ክዕወ 'pour')
glossary.ተኰርዐ: ተኰርዐ — he was struck (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ኰርዐ 'strike')
glossary.ተውህቦሙ: ተውህበ — it was given them (3ms perfect passive + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ተዐገሰ: ተዐገሰ — he endured, was patient (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ዐገሰ)
glossary.ተገብረ: ገብረ — it was done, made (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ገብረ)
glossary.ተገድፈ: ተገድፈ — he was cast out, thrown away (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ገደፈ)
glossary.ተጸፍዐ: ተጸፍዐ — he was slapped (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ጸፍዐ)
glossary.ተጽዕለ: ተጽዕለ — he was scorned (?) (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ጸዐለ; sense of the root not secure (?))
glossary.ተፀርፈ: ተፀርፈ — he was reviled (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ፀረፈ 'revile, blaspheme')
glossary.ታሰራሕ: አሠርሐ — prosper (?) (2ms imperfect/jussive, causative a-stem of ሠርሐ 'go forward, succeed'; the long vowel is irregular; uncertain (?))
glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ትሑት: ትሑት — humble, lowly (adj.) · the humble one, used as a noun (ለውእቱ ትሑት 'that humble one'; ትሑት 'Adam the humble one')
glossary.ትከውኑ: ኮነ — you (mp) are, will be (2mp imperfect, k-w-n)
glossary.ኀሠሥክዎሙ: ኀሠሠ — I sought them (1cs perfect G, ḫ-ś-ś, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ኀሳረ: ኀሳር — loss, ruin (accusative) · 'disgrace, insult' (?) of what the Passion brought on him (ኢኀፈረ ኀሳረ 'was not ashamed of the disgrace'; ተዐገሰ ኵሎ ኀሳረ 'endured every insult')
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀያል: ኀያል — strong, mighty (adjective; also 'a mighty one', noun)
glossary.ኀይል: ኀይል — strength, might (noun; construct ደቂቀ ኀይል 'sons of strength', i.e. the mighty)
glossary.ኅብራ: ሕብር — its form, kind, colour (?) (noun + -ሃ '3fs her/its'; as ሕብር in ch. 17–20 and 64–65; the printed ኅ for ሕ) (?)
glossary.ነሢአክሙ: ነሥአ — you having received (gerund 2mp ነሢአክሙ, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ነዋኀ: ነዋኅ — far, long (adjective; accusative used as an adverb 'far')
glossary.ንብኪዮሙ: በከየ — let us weep for them (1cp jussive G, b-k-y, + -ዮሙ '3mp them')
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አሕፃከ: ሐጽ — arrows (noun, as ሐጽ in ch. 96a; plural አሕጻ/አሕፃ + -ከ '2ms your'; the printed spelling differs from the usual one)
glossary.አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
glossary.አመነ: አምነ — he believed (3ms perfect of አምነ 'believe, have faith', with በ- 'in'; after plural እለ, an irregular match: distributive, or slip for አመኑ (?))
glossary.አመንክሙ: አምነ — you believed (2mp perfect, a-stem of ʾ-m-n)
glossary.አምላክ: አምላክ — God, god (noun, singular; here 'a God') · 'god' in ዘእምአምላክ 'that is from god' (no article)
glossary.አምዕዑኒ: አምዐ — they provoked me to anger (3mp perfect + -ኒ '1cs me'; written with doubled ዕ, so the stem is uncertain (?), as in the earlier parts)
glossary.አርትዕ: አርተዐ — make straight, set right (?) (2ms imperative, causative a-stem of ርትዐ 'be straight, upright'; here perhaps 'proceed rightly') (?)
glossary.አርድእት: ረድእ — disciples (noun, plural አርድእት of ረድእ)
glossary.አብ: አብ — father (the Father) · a father in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ)
glossary.አብዲ: አበደ — they raged, were mad (3mp perfect, read as አብዱ with -ዲ for -ዱ as in ኢይፈቅዲ; ʾ-b-d) (?)
glossary.አኃዜ: አኀዘ — holder, seizer of (construct of agent noun አኃዚ, ʾ-ḫ-z; 'holder-of') (?)
glossary.አእመሩ: አእመረ — they knew (3mpl perfect, a-stem, ʿ-m-r)
glossary.አኮኑ: አኮ — is it not so? are we not? (negative አኮ + interrogative -ኑ)
glossary.አይሁድ: አይሁድ — the Jews (noun, plural; the dependent noun after the construct ሕዝበ)
glossary.አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible · Adam, in ዘመደ አዳም 'the kin of Adam' (the human race; ch. 53) · (?) as predicate in ኢኮነ አዳም 'it is not comely' (of ላሕይ 'appearance'), read like the earlier predicate use, 'pleasing, comely' (?); 'ruddy' (cf. አደመ 'be red') is the alternative (?)
glossary.አድኀኖ: አድኀነ — he saved him (3ms perfect, causative a-stem of ድኅነ + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.አጠየቀ: ጠየቀ — he made exact, made precise (3ms perfect, causative a-stem of ṭ-y-q) (?)
glossary.አጽኒኖ: አጽነነ — bowing, inclining (?) (gerund 3ms, a-stem; lemma uncertain (?))
glossary.አፅምኡኒኬ: አጽምዐ — listen to me, then (2mp imperative, causative a-stem of አጽምዐ, as in ch. 28, + -ኒ '1cs me' + enclitic -ኬ 'then')
glossary.አፉሁ: አፍ — his mouth (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; the stem is አፉ- before the suffix)
glossary.ኢሰቀልዎ: ሰቀለ — they did not crucify him (ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect, G, s-q-l, + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ኢትትዐወቅ: ተዐወቀ — is not known (ኢ- 'not' + 3fs imperfect, tä-stem passive of ዐወቀ 'know')
glossary.ኢኮነ: ኮነ — he did not become (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n) · 'is not' with a predicate (ዝሰ ኢኮነ አምላክ 'this is not a god'; ch. 13)
glossary.ኢዐቀብክሙ: ዐቀበ — you did not keep (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp perfect G, ʿ-q-b)
glossary.ኢይፈቅዲ: ፈቀደ — they do not wish (ኢ- 'not' + imperfect G ይፈቅዲ, f-q-d; 3mp would be ይፈቅዱ, so the final -ዲ is irregular, perhaps scribal) (?)
glossary.ኢፈርሀ: ፈርሀ — he did not fear (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect G, f-r-h)
glossary.ኣቀንኦሙ: አቅንአ — I will make them jealous (1cs imperfect, causative a-stem of ቀንአ 'be zealous, jealous' + -ሙ '3mp them'; initial ኣ for አ)
glossary.ኣፍቀርክዎሙ: አፍቀረ — I loved them (1cs perfect G, ʾ-f-q-r, + -ሙ '3mp them'; initial ኣ for አ)
glossary.እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return') · in case, perhaps (እመ ይሁበከ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'perhaps God may give you offspring') · mother (እም, accusative, predicate: ወኮነተኪ እመ 'and she became a mother to you')
glossary.እመሕያው: እመሕያው — mankind, human being (noun; compound of እም 'mother' + ሕያው 'living'; genitive after እጓለ)
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel') · 'above' in ተሰብሐ እምነ ኵሎሙ 'was praised above (?) all of them', or possibly the agent 'by' (?) · partitive 'of, from among' (እምነ ፸ አርድእት 'of the seventy disciples')
glossary.እምነቢያት: ነቢይ — than the prophets (እም- 'than, from' + plural ነቢያት; comparative)
glossary.እምኔሆሙ: እም — from them, out of them (preposition + 3mp suffix, stem እምኔ-)
glossary.እምኔየ: እም — than me (እም- + -ኔየ '1s me') · 'from me' (ትርሐቅ እምኔየ 'that you go far from me')
glossary.እምከናፍሪከ: ከንፈር — from your lips (እም- 'from' + ከናፍር, plural of ከንፈር 'lip', + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.እምኵሉ: ኵሉ — out of all, from all (እም- 'from' + ኵሉ) · more than all (እምኵሉ with አፍቀረተኪ 'she loved you more than all') · 'by all' after a passive (እሴባሕ እምኵሉ መላእክት 'I am praised by all the angels')
glossary.እምውሉደ: ወልድ — than the children of (እም- 'than, from' + ውሉድ, plural of ወልድ 'child, son', construct state 'children-of')
glossary.እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun) · 'beyond what' (እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had expected') · 'from what' (እምዘ ንኤዝዘከ 'from what we command you') · 'since' of time (እምዘ ኀለፉ 'since they passed') · 'in respect of what' (እምዘ ንሰምዕ 'in what we hear')
glossary.እምፍጥረተ: ፍጥረት — from the creation of (እም- 'from' + ፍጥረት, construct state 'creation-of')
glossary.እራሑ: እራሑ — unidentified noun (?); context (ሰፊሖ 'stretching out', the crucifixion) suggests 'his arms', but the word may be corrupt, perhaps for እደዊሁ 'his hands' (?)
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took') · 'in which, through which' before በ- + suffix (እንተ ባቲ 'which in her') · 'the one' in እንተ የማኑ 'that of his right', and before a verb with suffix, 'which founded it' (እንተ ሣረረታ)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እደዊነ: እድ — our hands (noun, fem., plural እደው/እደዊ- before a suffix + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.እጓለ: እጓል — offspring, sons of (noun; construct 'offspring of'; እጓለ እመሕያው 'human beings')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
glossary.ኬ: ኬ — then, so (enclitic particle, here written as a separate word)
glossary.ክሉል: ክሉል — encircled, ringed (passive participle of ከለለ; adjective)
glossary.ክርስቲያኑ: ክርስቲያን — his church (ቤተ ክርስቲያኑ 'his house of Christians'; noun + -ሁ 'his')
glossary.ክፍለ: ክፍል — division of (noun, construct) · accusative, predicate 'a share, sharers' (ትከውኑ ክፍለ ምስሌነ 'you will be sharers with us')
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine') · 'it was' of time (ሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'when it was time for supper'); ወኮነ ፀዋገ 'he became (grim)' · 3ms used with a feminine subject, ኮነ ሚጦተ 'became a turning' said of the rod (then ኮነት) (?)
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this' · ኵሉ ዘ- 'all who' (ኵሉ ዘሞአ 'all who conquered')
glossary.ኵሎ: ኵሉ — all (accusative) · 'everything', used alone (እሰፍን ኵሎ 'I measure everything')
glossary.ወሃቤ: ወሃቢ — giver of (agent noun of ወሀበ 'give', construct ወሃቤ; the initial ወ is a root letter, not 'and', as in ወወሃቤ ch. 24; ወሃቤ ሲሳይ 'giver of food')
glossary.ወለሊሁ: ለሊሁ — and he himself (ወ- + ለሊሁ, emphatic reflexive pronoun, ለሊ- + -ሁ '3ms')
glossary.ወለአረሚ: አረሚ — and for the heathen, pagan (ወ- + ለ- 'for' + አረሚ, noun)
glossary.ወለክቡር: ክቡር — and the honored one (ወ- + ለ- + ክቡር 'honored, glorious', adjective used as noun)
glossary.ወለጽኑዕሰ: ጽኑዕ — and as for the strong one (ወ- + ለ- topic/object marker + ጽኑዕ 'strong' + enclitic -ሰ 'indeed')
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወልድ: ወልድ — son (the Son) · a son in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ 'a father's blessing upon a son')
glossary.ወሎቱሰ: ለ — and him, as for him (ወ- + ሎቱ 'to him' + contrastive -ሰ; ለ- marks the object, ወሎቱሰ ፈጠርክዎ 'but him I created')
glossary.ወሐቀዩ: ሐቀየ — and they gnashed (the teeth) (ወ- + 3mp perfect G, ḥ-q-y; the sense is required by ስነኒሆሙ 'their teeth' and Acts 7:54, and the verb is not secure to me) (?)
glossary.ወመላኬ: መላኪ — and master, ruler of (?) (ወ- + መላኪ, agent noun, construct state in -ē 'ruler-of'; as in ch. 40) (?)
glossary.ወመንፈሱ: መንፈስ — and his spirit (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወመድኀኔ: መድኀኒ — and savior of (ወ- + መድኀኒ 'savior', construct state in -ē 'savior-of')
glossary.ወማርቆስ: ማርቆስ — and Mark (proclitic ወ- 'and' + proper name)
glossary.ወምራቀ: ምራቅ — and spittle of (ወ- + ምራቅ 'spittle', construct state 'spittle-of')
glossary.ወምንተ: ምንት — and what? (ወ- 'and' + interrogative pronoun, accusative)
glossary.ወራእዩ: ራእይ — and his appearance (ወ- + ራእይ 'appearance, sight, vision' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወርትዕ: ርትዕ — and uprightness, rightness (ወ- + ርትዕ, noun)
glossary.ወሶበሰ: ሶበ — and if, and when (ወ- 'and' + conjunction + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወቀተሉ: ቀተለ — and they killed (ወ- + 3mp perfect G, q-t-l)
glossary.ወበላሕይከ: ላሕይ — and in your comeliness (ወ- + በ- 'in' + ላሕይ 'comeliness, beauty' + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወበልቦሙሰ: ልብ — and in their hearts, indeed (ወ- + በ- 'in' + ልብ 'heart' + -ሙ '3mp their' + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወበእስትንፋሰ: እስትንፋስ — and by the breath of (ወ- + በ- 'by' + እስትንፋስ 'breath', construct state 'breath-of')
glossary.ወበእንተዝኬ: በእንተዝ — and therefore, for this reason (ወ- + በእንተ + ዝ 'this' + -ኬ)
glossary.ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወበውስተ: ውስተ — and within, in (ወ- + በ- + ውስተ)
glossary.ወተቀኒዎ: ተቀነወ — and (being) nailed, pierced (ወ- + gerund 3ms of the tä-stem of ቀነወ 'pierce, nail', the verb from which ቅንዋት 'nails' comes)
glossary.ወተፈጥሩ: ተፈጥረ — and they were created (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem passive of ፈጠረ)
glossary.ወኀበርነ: ኀበረ — and we were joined, united (ወ- + 1cp perfect G ኀበርነ, ḫ-b-r; a 3ms verb with 'us' would be ኀበረነ)
glossary.ወኅሱር: ኅሱር — and lowly, diminished (?) (ወ- + adjective ኅሱር 'lacking, poor')
glossary.ወንሕነኒ: ንሕነ — and we too (ወ- + 1cp pronoun + emphatic -ኒ)
glossary.ወንዜንወክሙ: ዜነወ — and we declare to you (ወ- + 1cp imperfect, z-n-w, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ወንገሥ: ነግሠ — and reign! (ወ- + 2ms imperative G, n-g-ś)
glossary.ወአምሳለ: አምሳል — and likeness of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወአበዩ: አበየ — and they refused (ወ- + 3mp perfect, ʾ-b-y)
glossary.ወአንትሙኒ: አንትሙ — and you too (ወ- + 2mp pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወኢምንተኒ: ምንት — and not anything, nothing (ወ- + ኢ- + 'what' + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወኢረከብክዎሙ: ረከበ — and I did not find them (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 1cs perfect G, r-k-b, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወኢተሰጥዉኒ: ተሰጥወ — and they did not answer me (?) (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect tä-stem + -ኒ '1cs me'; lemma uncertain (?))
glossary.ወኢኀፈረ: ኀፈረ — and he was not ashamed (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect G, ḫ-f-r)
glossary.ወኢኮነ: ኮነ — and was/is not (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
glossary.ወእለሰ: እለ — and those who indeed (ወ- + relative pl. + ሰ 'indeed')
glossary.ወከማሁ: ከማሁ — and likewise (ወ- 'and' + adverb, 'like him, thus')
glossary.ወከንቶ: ከንቶ — and in vain (ወ- + ከንቶ, adverb 'in vain, emptily')
glossary.ወኮኑ: ኮነ — and they came to be, became (ወ- + 3mp perfect G, k-w-n)
glossary.ወወሃቤ: ወሃቢ — and giver of (ወ- + agent noun, construct ወሃቤ)
glossary.ወውስቴታ: ውስተ — and in it, in her (ወ- + preposition ውስተ, ውስቴ- + -ታ '3fs her/it', the form of the suffix on prepositions)
glossary.ወዘርኢነ: ርእየ — and that which we saw (proclitic ወ- 'and' + ዘ- 'that which' + 1cp perfect G ርኢነ, r-ʾ-y)
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዘእንበሌሁሰ: ዘእንበለ — and without him (ወ- + ዘእንበለ 'without' (preposition) + -ሁ '3ms him' + enclitic -ሰ 'indeed')
glossary.ወዘገሰሳ: ገሰሰ — and that which touched (ወ- + ዘ- 'that which' + 3fp perfect G ገሰሳ, g-s-s; the subject እደዊነ 'our hands' is feminine plural)
glossary.ወዘጠየቅነ: ጠየቀ — and that which we examined closely (ወ- + ዘ- 'that which' + 1cp perfect G, ṭ-y-q)
glossary.ወዝንቱኒ: ዝንቱ — and this too (ወ- 'and' + ዝንቱ 'this', m. sg. demonstrative, + enclitic -ኒ 'also, indeed')
glossary.ወየውሃት: የውሃት — and meekness, gentleness (ወ- + የውሃት, noun)
glossary.ወየዐርግ: ዐርገ — and it goes up (ወ- + 3ms imperfect G, ʿ-r-g)
glossary.ወያነጽሑ: አንጽሐ — and they cleanse (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, causative a-stem of ንጽሐ 'be clean')
glossary.ወያአምር: አእመረ — and he knows (ወ- + 3ms imperfect ያአምር, a-stem of ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ወይ: ብህለ — and he said (first half of ወይ ፡ ቤ, read as ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of ብህለ, split by a stray wordspace) (?)
glossary.ወይርግዝዎሙ: ረገዘ — and let them strike them (?) (ወ- + 3mp imperfect/jussive G + -ሙ '3mp them'; sense uncertain (?))
glossary.ወይትመሐፀኑ: ተመሐፀነ — and they take refuge (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, tä-stem of መሐፀነ 'entrust')
glossary.ወይኔስሑ: ነስሐ — and they repent (ወ- + 3mp imperfect G ይኔስሑ, n-s-ḥ)
glossary.ወዳዊትሰ: ዳዊት — and David, for his part (ወ- 'and' + ዳዊት + enclitic -ሰ 'indeed, for his part')
glossary.ወዳግመ: ዳግም — and again (ወ- + ዳግመ, adverbial accusative 'a second time, again')
glossary.ወገብረ: ገብረ — and he did (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወግብራ: ግብር — and her work, making (ወ- + noun + -ሃ 'her')
glossary.ወጸልኡኒ: ጸልአ — and they hated me (ወ- + 3mp perfect G, ṣ-l-ʾ, + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወጸዐልዎ: ጸዐለ — and they scorned him (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect G, ṣ-ʿ-l, + -ዎ '3ms him'; sense of the root not secure (?))
glossary.ወጽላሎታ: ጽላሎት — and its shadow (ወ- + ጽላሎት 'shadow' + -ሃ '3fs her/its', ጽላሎታ)
glossary.ወጽዕለተ: ጽዕለት — and scorn (?) (ወ- + ጽዕለት, noun from ጸዐለ, accusative; sense not secure (?))
glossary.ወፈደዮሙ: ፈደየ — and he repaid them (ወ- + 3ms perfect G, f-d-y, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወ፬: ፬ — and 4, spoken ወአርባዕተ (wä-ʾarbaʿtä) 'and four' (ወ- + numeral; the accusative before a masculine noun, as spelled out in ch. 46; አርባዕ ʾarbaʿ with a feminine noun)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — as for him (3ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ዐውከኩ: ዐወከ — they were confused, disturbed (?) (perfect; the ending -ኩ is normally 1cs, but the relative እለ requires a 3mp, so the form is irregular or corrupt; lemma doubtful)
glossary.ዕለተ: ዕለት — day (noun, fem., construct state 'day-of') · also the accusative singular after a numeral (፯ ዕለተ 'seven days')
glossary.ዘሀሎ: ሀሎ — who is (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms perfect G ሀሎ, 'be, exist', stative: 'is')
glossary.ዘህገሩ: ሀገር — whose city, homeland (ዘ- 'whose' + ሀገር 'city, country' + -ሁ '3ms his'; spelled with ህ for ሀ)
glossary.ዘለዓለም: ለዓለም — everlasting, eternal (ዘ- 'of' + ለዓለም 'for ever'; ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity') · 'for ever' as an adverb after a noun (ደዌ ዘለዓለም 'sickness for ever')
glossary.ዘልዑል: ልዑል — that which is high, the height (ዘ- 'that which' + ልዑል 'high, the Most High'; ላዕለ ዘልዑል 'above the heights')
glossary.ዘርኩሳን: ርኩስ — of the unclean (ዘ- 'of' + ርኩሳን, plural of the adjective ርኩስ 'unclean')
glossary.ዘሰማዕነ: ሰምዐ — what we heard, that which we heard (ዘ- + 1cp perfect, G, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ዘቅድስት: ቅድስት — of holy (ዘ- 'of' + ቅድስት, fem. of ቅዱስ 'holy'; ዘቅድስት ኢየሩሳሌም 'of holy Jerusalem')
glossary.ዘቤተ: ቤት — of the house of (ዘ- 'of, that of' + ቤተ, construct 'house of')
glossary.ዘብዴዎስ: ዘብዴዎስ — Zebedee (proper name; ወልደ ዘብዴዎስ 'son of Zebedee')
glossary.ዘተብህለ: ተብህለ — which was said (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect passive of ብህለ)
glossary.ዘኢኮነ: ኮነ — who was not (ዘ- 'who' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect G, k-w-n)
glossary.ዘኢዐቀቡ: ዐቀበ — that they did not keep (ዘ- 'that' + ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect G, ʿ-q-b)
glossary.ዘኢያአምሩ: አእመረ — which they do not know (ዘ- 'which' + ኢ- 'not' + 3mp imperfect, IV, ʾ-ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ዘኢይደልዎ: ደለወ — that which does not befit him (ዘ- 'that which' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect G ይደሉ, d-l-w, + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘኣፍቀርክዎሙ: አፍቀረ — those whom I loved (ዘ- 'that which, those whom' + 1cs perfect G + -ሙ '3mp them'; initial ኣ for አ)
glossary.ዘእምብርሃን: ብርሃን — that (is) from light (ዘ- 'that which' + እም- 'from' + noun ብርሃን 'light')
glossary.ዘእምአምላክ: አምላክ — that (is) from god (ዘ- 'that which' + እም- 'from' + noun አምላክ 'god')
glossary.ዘእምአብ: አብ — which (is) from the Father (ዘ- 'which' + እም- 'from' + አብ 'father')
glossary.ዘኮነ: ኮነ — that which was (ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms perfect, k-w-n)
glossary.ዘውእቱ: ውእቱ — who is, namely (ዘ- relative + 3ms pronoun)
glossary.ዘያአምሮ: አእመረ — who knows him (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms imperfect ያአምር, a-stem of ʿ-m-r, + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ዝውእቱ: ውእቱ — this is he, that is (he who) · 'this very one', ዝ + ውእቱ in apposition (ዝውእቱ ብሩሀ ገጽ ይኩን 'let this one, bright of face, be…')
glossary.ያሐዝኖ: አሐዘነ — it grieves him (3ms imperfect, causative a-stem of ሐዘነ + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.ያመልኩኒ: አመለከ — they worship me (3mp imperfect G, ʾ-m-l-k, + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ያመስሉ: አምሰለ — they liken (3mp imperfect, causative a-stem of መሰለ 'be like')
glossary.ያምጽእዎሙ: አምጽአ — let them bring them / bring them (3mp jussive, causative a-stem of መጽአ + -ሙ '3mp them'; used as a command) (?)
glossary.ያርኢ: አርአየ — he shows (3ms imperfect, a-stem causative of ርእየ 'see')
glossary.ያርእዮሙ: አርአየ — he shows them (3ms imperfect, causative of ርእየ + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ያስተሴንዮ: አስተሠነየ — he adorns, praises him (?) (3ms imperfect, Št-stem of ሠነየ 'be beautiful' + -ሁ '3ms him'; sense uncertain (?))
glossary.ያንግሡኒ: አንገሠ — they make me king (3mp imperfect, causative a-stem of ነግሠ + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ያአምር: አእመረ — he knows, discerns (3ms imperfect, caus., ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ያጽንዖ: አጽንዐ — he may strengthen him (3ms jussive, causative a-stem of ጸንዐ, + -ሁ '3ms him'; after ከመ)
glossary.ያፈቅሮሙ: አፍቀረ — he loves them (3ms imperfect + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይሤኒ: ሠነየ — he is handsome, beautiful (3ms imperfect, G) · 'becomes beautiful', intransitive (በትእምርተ መስቀል ይሤኒ ኵሉ 'by the sign of the cross all becomes beautiful')
glossary.ይረትዕ: ረትዐ — he is true, right (3ms imperfect, r-t-ʿ)
glossary.ይርሕቁ: ርሕቀ — they are far, go far away (3mp imperfect, G, r-ḥ-q; intransitive)
glossary.ይርግዝዎሙ: ረገዘ — they strike them (?) (3mp imperfect G, r-g-z, + -ሙ '3mp them'; sense uncertain (?))
glossary.ይስዐሮ: ሰዐረ — he may defeat him (3ms jussive G, s-ʿ-r, + -ሁ '3ms him'; after ከመ)
glossary.ይቀትልዎ: ቀተለ — they kill him (3mp imperfect G, q-t-l, + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.ይቀውም: ቆመ — he stands (3ms imperfect G, q-w-m)
glossary.ይበክዩ: በከየ — they weep (3mp imperfect G, b-k-y)
glossary.ይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — he said to them (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 'let them say, let them call' (3mp jussive, ሎሙሰ ይብሉ አማልክቲሆሙ 'as for them, let them call them their gods')
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይነብር: ነበረ — he stays, dwells (3ms imperfect, G, n-b-r) · he sits, is seated (3ms imperfect, G, of sitting at table) · he will sit, take the seat (ዝንቱ ይነብር ህየንቴሁ 'this one will sit in his place')
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ይጼውዕዎ: ጸውዐ — they call him (3mp imperfect G ይጼውዑ, ṣ-w-ʿ, + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.ደክመ: ደክመ — he became weak (3ms perfect G, d-k-m)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ድኩምሰ: ድኩም — the weak (adjective used as noun) + enclitic -ሰ 'indeed, for his part'
glossary.ገበርነ: ገብረ — we do (1cp perfect, G, after ለእመ 'if')
glossary.ገባሪ: ገባሪ — maker, doer (agent noun of ገብረ)
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
glossary.ገኒየ: ገነየ — submission, bowing (?) (a form of ገነየ 'bow, submit, serve', taken as a verbal noun or gerund-like form; the ending is not the regular gerund -ዖ; uncertain lexical call (?))
glossary.ጠይቅ: ጠየቀ — examine, investigate (2ms imperative, G, ṭ-y-q)
glossary.ጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — certain, exact; 'certainly' (adjective, accusative/adverbial form in -a)
glossary.ጸዋዕክዎሙ: ጸውዐ — I called them (1cs perfect G, ṣ-w-ʿ, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ጽምእት: ጽሙእ — dry, thirsty (adjective, fem. ጽምእት, agreeing with ምድር 'land')
glossary.ጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — righteousness, justice (noun; ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness')
glossary.ፀራ: ፀር — enemies of (?) (noun ፀር 'enemy'; ፀራ here appears plural/construct before ለጽድቅ 'of righteousness'; form uncertain (?))
glossary.ፈላሴ: ፈላሲ — sojourner, stranger (?) (noun, accusative in -ē as in ገባሬ, object of ቀተሉ; the word itself is uncertain (?))
glossary.ፈደዩኒ: ፈደየ — they repaid me (3mp perfect G, f-d-y, + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ፈድፋደ: ፈድፋደ — exceedingly, greatly (adverb) · 'especially' before a numeral (ፈድፋደ ፯ እምኔሆሙ 'especially seven of them') (?)
glossary.ፈጠረ: ፈጠረ — he created (3ms perfect, G, f-ṭ-r)
glossary.ፈጣሪ: ፈጣሪ — creator, maker (noun; participle of ፈጠረ)
glossary.ፍጥረተ: ፍጥረት — creation, creature (noun, accusative; object of ገብረ 'made')
glossary.፯: ፯ — 7, spoken ሰብዐቱ (säbʿatu) 'seven'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'seven' (፯ ዕለተ 'seven days') · after a feminine noun (ዓመት ፯ 'seven years'), spoken ሰብዐ (säbʿa) (?); placed after its noun it may also be the ordinal 'seventh', ሳብዕ (sabʿ) (?) · before a noun, 'seven' (፯ ሰማያት 'seven heavens') (spoken ሰብዐቱ (säbʿatu), as the numeral stands before its noun (?))
glossary.፻፪: ፻፪ — spoken ምእት ወክልኤቱ (məʾət wä-kəlʾetu) 'one hundred and two' (numeral; chapter number: ፻ = 100, ፪ = 2)
